accessibility.title: Backend-hosted Qwen wiki generation flow
accessibility.description: A serialized GitHub Actions job sends an authenticated Responses API request through Caddy and a bounded proxy to loopback Ollama, then validates the generated documentation before publication.

review_notes: Verify the protected backend apply run and real Qwen tool-call proof remain linked from the deployment record.
Benchmark output quality and latency before increasing the batch size, model context, or output ceiling.
Review generated documentation after every pinned Ollama or Qwen model upgrade.
